guard: a spawn that launched its seat and then threw is rolled back through the static terminal, which reaps the custody reference the spawn reserved on the slot row before launch, and retains the lifecycle when that seat is not proved gone
why: The suite parks a real manager in the onLaunched callback, after the seat custodian and child exist and before the slot activation CAS, then releases it into a throw. The rollback drives the static terminal in the same process.

Since T3 the terminal reaps only the slot row reference, never the caller reference, so the guarded facts are that the reservation is durably on the row before the spawn and that the terminal reaps from the row. Each mutation breaks one of them and the terminal retains as no-reference instead of addressing the launched seat.

mutations.name: write the spawn intent without the reserved custody reference
mutations.expectRed: the rollback reaps the reference the spawn reserved and RETAINS the lifecycle (unprovable, refused, release remedy)
mutations.cell: the rollback reaps the reference the spawn reserved and RETAINS the lifecycle (unprovable, refused, release remedy)
